title: ECHS Notification 2026 - Apply Offline for 96 Medical Specialist, Pharmacist, Dental Officer and Other Posts
description: Ex-Servicemen Contributory Health Scheme (ECHS) has announced the latest notification for the recruitment of 96 Medical Specialists, Pharmacists, Dental Officers, Nursing Assistants, Safaiwalas, and Other Jobs. Candidates who have qualified for 10th Pass, 08th, Any Degree, B.Pharm, B.Sc, B.Sc Nursing, BDS, Diploma, GNM, MBBS, MD/ MS can take this opportunity to apply for the ECHS Notification 2026 . Here, we have included the age limit, selection process, salary structure, education details, ...
